items: Fixed: Windows Defender could flag Desk Buddy as a threat. It no longer uses PowerShell to eject the Kindle
Added: a green "Kindle connected" badge on Home
Fixed: putting Desk Buddy on a Kindle that had it before keeps its cover in the library
Added: put Desk Buddy on a Kindle from here: plug it in with USB and click once (Kindle page). It's set up to connect by itself. Or save the files and copy them yourself
Added: About › Updates: check for updates, see what's new before you install, and look back at what came in each version
Added: Desk Buddy updates itself (Update Desk Buddy at the bottom of the sidebar)
Changed: the window matches the Mac app: the same pages and icons, and a sidebar you can fold
Added: drag and drop in the task list
Added: Desk Buddy can run on this PC (Server › This PC)
Added: the Desk Buddy window: your tasks, every Kindle setting, this PC and the server
First version: connects this PC to the Kindle from the tray (in use, light or dark, the Deck)
